bullets.bullet_text: Led quantitative derivatives, variable-annuity hedging, and insurance-capital modeling engagements, applying exotic options pricing, multi-Greek hedge design, and higher-order stress testing to deliver defensible capital adequacy outcomes for regulated clients.

Directed CCAR-era capital, liquidity, and stress-testing programs, structuring traceable scenario and challenger-model frameworks alongside model-risk remediation to produce audit-grade governance evidence for regulators.

Architected enterprise risk management operating models aligned to BCBS 239, defining three-lines-of-defense accountability, metadata standards, and auditable risk-aggregation metrics across regulated financial institutions.
